_help: ARCHETYPE: TEMPLATE. This file grants tool permissions and wires up the hook scripts in .claude/hooks/. PERSONALISE: (1) widen the 'allow' list with read-only commands you run constantly so you stop being prompted for them; (2) tighten 'deny' for anything that must never run unattended; (3) keep only the hooks whose scripts you actually copied — a hook registered here but missing on disk will error, and a hook script on disk does nothing until it's registered here. JSON has no comments, so this guidance lives in _help — DELETE this _help key once you've personalised the file.
